name: Genshin Impact: Lumine's Reverse Harem
body: A reverse-harem story about Lumine set in canon Teyvat. No lore recaps. Every sex scene is explicit and dirty, but each one has a concrete story reason driving it—jealousy, a deal, a debt, loneliness, spite, comfort after violence, power play. Lumine actively wants and pursues sex; she is not passive. Show messy relationship consequences—resentment, negotiation, secrets, tenderness that feels earned, not cute. The tone is adult and intense.

prompts.text: After Lumine nearly dies fighting alongside Childe, he fucks her against a ruin wall still wet with blood because the adrenaline hasn't faded.
Diluc discovers she slept with Kaeya and, hard with jealous want, takes her in his winery cellar—gloves on, no words, just rough use against the barrels.
Xiao, eaten alive by karmic debt, corners Lumine and fucks her with desperate, punishing speed, needing to bury his pain in her body.
